primary_goal: give component-preset persistence failures one stable direct and HTTP error contract
method: prepare -> verify -> predict -> score -> review -> promote

baseline.role: current engineering baseline after round_012 and workflow closure rule

scope.operator: ComponentPresetCatalog persistence and all HTTP component-preset entry points
scope.phase: read, write, lock, startup, and error-envelope handling
scope.trigger: malformed JSON, invalid existing record/version/list, unreadable directory path, lock failure, or atomic save failure

problem_domain_closure.architecture_indirect_component_read: covered by the same GET catch
problem_domain_closure.startup: fail-fast ComponentPresetPersistenceError; CLI catches the ValueError-compatible type
problem_domain_closure.client_payload_validation: unchanged ComponentPresetMutationError statuses and not_found behavior

data_roles.development: malformed JSON, bad version/list/record, and directory-path failures
data_roles.holdout: architecture detail indirect read and save/lock failure paths

guardrails: do not turn malformed persistence into a successful stale read
keep valid payload validation and 404/409 semantics unchanged
keep startup fail-fast rather than starting a half-initialized catalog
do not expose local paths or raw JSON exceptions through HTTP
run clean .venv full suite before promotion
next_step: review semantic validation of tombstones and duplicate persisted IDs as a separate persistence-schema hypothesis
